z_stability.note: z_census comes from the submitted probe; z_big from a freshly trained mean-pooled head, so that comparison mixes two changes. The z_at_100 columns hold everything fixed except the number of draws and are the clean measurement.

draw_count_instability.interpretation: A z threshold of 4.02 is what BH survival required. If a single 100-draw subsample can push an enhancer over that line while the 1000-draw estimate does not, the census survivors are largely sampling noise in the shuffle SD denominator.

tail_agreement.note: With 1000 draws the smallest attainable empirical p is 1/1001 = 1.0e-3, still above the BH threshold of 5.9e-5, so the empirical column can only bound the parametric one, not replace it; the GPD column is the only one that can reach the threshold from finite draws.
